description: Capability for the always-on-top MCP activity overlay window. Scoped narrowly: the overlay only needs to receive Tauri events (tool-call-event) and call the overlay-control commands defined in the desktop app — no shell, dialog, updater, or other plugin access. Also permits the temporary `overlay_diag_log` debug bridge (tagged `overlay-diag` in lib.rs / `overlay-bridge` in overlay.rs) so the overlay renderer can surface its own logs in the dev terminal; gated to this window via an in-command label check.
